# SpeakUpp

> AI-powered speaking practice for English, French, and Arabic. Pick a topic, think for 3 minutes, speak for 1, and get instant feedback on pronunciation, fluency, grammar, and vocabulary.

SpeakUpp helps language learners build real speaking fluency through short, focused sessions with AI feedback and progress tracking.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Landing page with how-it-works overview and supported languages.
- [Sign up](/signup): Create an SpeakUpp account.
- [Sign in](/login): Sign in to an existing account.
